text: One of the reasons that this international group of scholars have come together around the research in the Mosfell Valley, is that the location is mentioned often in the Medieval Icelandic written sources including the famous Icelandic Sagas. The Mosfell region is mentioned in Egils Saga, The Book of Settlements, The Saga of Gunnlaug Worms-Tongue, Hallfreds Saga, The Saga of the Men of Kjalarness, The Saga of the Men of Flói Bay, The Short Story of Orm Stórolfsson, Harðars Saga and The Short Story of Thorstein Uxafót. Jesse Byock, the director of the Mosfell Project, says that this is an unusually rich historical record for Viking Age sites.
